def _chatter_pattern_translate(text, mapping): if text in mapping: return mapping[text]
for source, target in mapping.items(): if '%s' not in source: continue
parts = source.split('%s') if not text.startswith(parts[0]): continue
pos = len(parts[0]) values = [] ok = True
for index in range(1, len(parts)): part = parts[index]
if part: next_pos = text.find(part, pos) if next_pos < 0: ok = False break values.append(text[pos:next_pos]) pos = next_pos + len(part) else: if index == len(parts) - 1: values.append(text[pos:]) pos = len(text) else: ok = False break
if ok and pos == len(text): try: if len(values) == 1: return target % values[0] return target % tuple(values) except Exception: return target
return None
